name: AD820 / AD822 / AD824
tagline: Low-power ADI JFET amps with rail-to-rail outputs; a Japanese battery-CMoy pick likened to the OPA2134.

lineage.note: Sole maker; one JFET-input RRO design in single, dual and quad. Introduction date unconfirmed.
ADI product pages name the ADA4622-1/-2/-4 as the next generation.
'Redesign of the AD820 Single-Channel Circuit…' for the aRD820 low-noise RRO; not a commercial source.

part_numbers.note: Single; listed on analog.com. Datasheet Rev. H current.
SOIC-8, A / B grade; Octopart mirrors, BRZ copy holds Rev. G.
Dual, the hobbyist favourite; listed on analog.com. Datasheet Rev. J current.
Legacy non-Z code; probably the pre-Pb-free AD822ANZ (unconfirmed).
Quad; lower power, runs from 3 V single supply. Listed on analog.com.

key_specs.value: JFET; input range extends below V−; rail-to-rail out
key_specs.condition: AD822: within 10 mV of rails, light load

reputation.summary: Modest praise, mostly Japanese DIY. A zigsow review calls the AD822 a single-supply part that holds up well enough for audio. nabe hears a tendency like the OPA2134 with a cool FET character, and finds the OPA2350 fuller. Its very low current suits battery CMoy amps, though nabe notes transient problems into 15 Ω loads.
caveats: Designed as a low-power precision/instrumentation part, not for audio.
Limited drive: nabe reports transient problems into 15 Ω headphone loads.
Praise is lukewarm ('good enough for audio'), not legendary.

counterfeit_notes: No specific counterfeit reports. The DIP-8 AD822ANZ circulates widely in the hobby market, so buy from authorized distributors or reputable retailers such as Akizuki.
alternatives: OPA2350 (CMOS RRIO; nabe finds it fuller)

silicon_changes.summary: ADI qualifies its Camas, WA wafer fab for Complementary Bipolar (CB) products. Appendix A lists AD820, AD822 (ARZ, BRZ) and AD824ARZ-14 variants with AD812, AD817, OP467 and other families. Effective 30 July 2026.
silicon_changes.identification: Camas-fab material may ship from 30 July 2026; the PCN's qualification summary should give date-code or marking details.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: Unknown; qualification results not yet read. Same CB process, new fab site.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: medium: new wafer fab for the whole family; qualification data not yet checked.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN title, dates and affected-model list confirmed on analog.com; change details pending.

claims_confirmed: AD822 current datasheet is Rev. J (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD822.pdf)
AD822: 5–30 V single or ±2.5–±15 V, output within 10 mV of each rail (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD822.pdf)
AD820 current datasheet is Rev. H (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD820.pdf; https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=121457)
Octopart AD820BRZ mirror holds AD820 Rev. G (https://datasheet.octopart.com/AD820BRZ-Analog-Devices-datasheet-8455708.pdf)
AD820: 5–36 V single or ±2.5–±18 V, 1.8 MHz, 3 V/µs, 13 nV/√Hz at 10 kHz, 800 µA max (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD820.pdf)
AD824: 500 µA/amp, 2 MHz, 2 V/µs, 2 pA bias, 3 V to ±15 V (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD824.pdf)
ADA4622-1/-2/-4 are the next generation of the AD820/AD822/AD824 (https://www.analog.com/en/products/ada4622-2.html)
ADI PCN 26_0029 lists AD820, AD822, AD823, AD824 and AD8224 variants (https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/4778405.pdf)
ADI PCN 07_0024 Rev. E lists AD822 variants (https://www.analog.com/media/en/pcn/ADI_PCN_07_0024_Rev_E_Form.pdf)
PCN 26_0029: Camas WA wafer fab qualified for CB products; published 27 Apr 2026, effective 30 Jul 2026 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_26_0029_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
PCN 26_0029 Appendix A lists AD820ARZ, AD822ARZ, AD822BRZ and AD824ARZ-14 variants (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_26_0029_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
AD822 history: 7/93 Rev. 0; 8/08 G→H; 1/10 H→I; 9/15 I→J, changes to Figure 12 (https://xdevs.com/doc/_Datasheets/Amplifiers/AD822.pdf).
AD820 history: 3/11 Rev. G to Rev. H, changes to Figure 43 (https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/jp/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD820_JP.pdf).
AD824 history: 5/14 C→D removed 16-lead SOIC and dice data; 4/15 D→E Figure 1 caption (https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD824.pdf).
